source.rule: A tree evaluates complete root-to-leaf paths; NBREQ is the number of functional leaf paths required. Failure of a common mother disables every descendant path through it.

configuration.common: Accepted G04 three-position 2-of-3 active parallel parent with physical A/B failures, direct half-hour CM, h8–34 mission, seed1, one replication/horizon36. Add healthy POS-D with the same installed LRU and no D failure mode. Replace the parallel block with RBDTree G08-TREE NBREQ2 and three distinct leaves, each QTYPM1/G04-OPS. A/B failure modes/rates, repairs, mission, seed and all other business tables stay fixed.
configuration.roota: POS-A is common mother of B, C and D. B failure removes one of three leaf paths, leaving two; A failure removes every path.
configuration.rootb: POS-B is common mother of A, C and D. B failure removes every root-to-leaf path at once.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both tree arms import, export and calculate with zero converter errors or unreviewed diagnostics, preserving all populated source tables including RBDTree and RBDTreeStructure.

Under the fixed seed, the first B failure is noncritical in roota while two paths remain and critical in rootb because the common mother fails. If first-event identity or timing diverges, preserve the affected run as diagnostic and revise under a new version.
In roota, if A later fails while B remains failed, all paths become nonfunctional and the mission aborts. Native logs may show system criticality but not label individual tree paths.
native_acceptance: Two unique guarded session-0 SSH runs with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Direct event criticality and mission outcome contrasted between matched B/A physical failures, 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation and independent read-only replay.
diagnostic_gate: Retain any rejected arm and its raw evidence as diagnostic; revise with fresh version/run IDs instead of retroactively changing the frozen hypothesis.
limits: Single-root three-leaf tree with NBREQ2 and one common-mother permutation; multi-root, QTYPM>1, other NBREQ boundaries and nested switching remain separate G08 scope.
C/D healthy without failure modes; leaf-path identity is source-bound because native event logs may not name paths. No GUI drawing, online maintenance, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
